title: Dispatch: opus:F-09 vertical slice (attempt 1)
description:
Implement the opus:F-09 VERTICAL SLICE (design docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, revision 4, APPROVED in PR #589; section 8 step 2) — with ONE supervisor-made design amendment (A1 below). Read the whole design doc first; it is the authority. This spec records the supervisor's decisions and a code survey; where it is silent, follow the design.

Worktree/branch: .worktrees/<this bead id> on branch <this bead id>, cut from parent branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 (== origin/main de7df402).

## A1 — design amendment (supervisor decision, already made; you implement it)

The four R3 `duplicate-of` candidates FAILED source comparison as duplicates (supervisor compared against SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf via pdfjs):
- rule:armor-class (p.80) is the one-sentence "Armor Class" item under the Dexterity ability's uses ("Depending on the armor you wear, you might add some or all of your Dexterity modifier to your Armor Class."). rule:armor-guidance (pp.62-63) says armor determines BASE AC; the Dex rules are the Light/Medium Armor paragraphs. Not the same rule.
- rule:senses-darkvision (p.257, monster appendix) states "can see in dim light within the radius as if it were bright light"; rule:darkvision (p.86) does NOT contain that clause. Texts state different rules.
- rule:senses-truesight adds "within the same range" to the Ethereal Plane clause; rule:truesight does not.
- rule:senses-blindsight adds the naturally-blind parenthetical stat-block convention.
Pack text matches the PDF in all eight records (no extraction defect).
Therefore: NO `duplicateOf` field, NO importer change, NO pack regeneration, NO relationship-manifest change, NO field-provenance change, NO kindSchemas change in this slice. Emit nothing for these pairs.
Amend the design doc in this PR: add a short "Amendment A1 (vertical slice)" subsection at the end of §3 R3 recording the four comparisons above (the quoted differing clauses and page numbers), stating that no duplicate-of edge is emitted, and that whether a non-duplicate source relation (e.g. a parallel definition of the same sense in another chapter) is warranted is deferred to a follow-up bead (you create it: `bd create --type=task --priority=3 --title="Decide source relation for parallel sense definitions (rule:senses-* vs rule:*)"` with the evidence, parent eshyra-o9bd.19.3). Update §2's third example bullet, §4 invariant 8, §5 row 1 and §7/§8 wording accordingly. Change the doc Status line to "accepted (revision 4) + amendment A1 from the vertical slice". Keep edits minimal.
§5 row 1's permanent evidence ("bundled SRD record -> present, SRD semantics, resolved relationship through lookup_rules") is instead proven with `action:help`, whose `ruleRef` is already a declared, resolving `record-key` relationship (PR #582). Verify the exact pointer in records.json / record-relationships.json before writing the assertion.

## R0 outcomes for the slice rows (supervisor-derived; record each outcome + evidence in the PR description AND as a code comment beside the row's dataset entry)

1. rule:long-rest — legacy `unimplemented` is STALE -> RETIRED as a limit; REWRITTEN to implemented-not-positively-selected. Evidence: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRest.ts restTool(name,'long') + packages/core/src/state/rest.ts completeLongRest (qualification, 24 in-game hour gate "a participant already benefited from a long rest within 24 in-game hours", >=1 HP, HP/Hit Dice/resource resets); bead eshyra-2n1t.9 closed. Implementation: in ruleDispositions.ts UNBOUND_ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE change the row to status 'implemented' with runtimeOwner [toolRest.ts, state/rest.ts] and evidence = the real existing test file(s) that cover long rest (find them; do not invent), and add the key to IMPLEMENTED_ROWS_WITHOUT_SELECTED_CAPABILITY in src/rules/deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts (data only; contract unchanged). Do NOT add a binding.
2. rule:short-rest — meaningful sibling, same staleness (verify its current legacy row first). Same treatment if its row is also stale (restTool 'short', spend_rest_hit_die, finish_short_rest_recovery). If its row is already correct, leave it and say so.
3. rule:suffocating — `partial` CONFIRMED (no breath-duration or suffocation-countdown state anywhere in src/; the 0-HP/dying transition is applied by adjust_hp through state/hpLifecycle.ts). -> ruleKnownLimits entry, limit 'partial', findingId 'readiness-integrity' (what materializeEngineProcedureCoverage already assigns). Model-facing statement, e.g.: "Eshyra does not track how long a creature has held its breath or the suffocation round countdown; the DM tracks both from this rule. When the creature drops to 0 hit points, apply it with adjust_hp, which runs the dying rules." (Tool names must be validated against DEFAULT_TOOLS.)
4. rule:charges — REWRITTEN. The external clause 'pack-side charge data' (eshyra-o9bd.18.7.7.1) is RETIRED: that bead is closed and the pack carries charge economies (e.g. magic-item:wand-of-magic-missiles data.mechanics.economies.charges {max:7, reset dawn 1d6+1, onDepleted}). Live expenditure/reset are spend_usage/reset_usage (verify restore_usage exists before naming it). What survives is disclosure adjudication: remaining charges are revealed by identify or attunement, and the attuned creature learns how many charges were regained. -> NO known limit; ruleAdjudicationContext entry with tools [lookup_rules, spend_usage, reset_usage(, restore_usage if it exists)] and dmContext about disclosure timing. The audit coverage row therefore becomes 'model-adjudicated-supported' sourced from the runtime dataset.
5. rule:cover — adjudication context CONFIRMED: tools [lookup_rules, resolve_check]; dmContext: the DM chooses the degree of cover; the +2 / +5 AC and Dexterity saving throw bonuses must be passed as declared modifiers to resolve_check; total cover means the target can't be targeted directly.
6. rule:opportunity-attacks — adjudication context CONFIRMED if spend_turn_resource exists in DEFAULT_TOOLS (verify): tools [lookup_rules, roll, spend_turn_resource]; dmContext: the DM rules on the trigger and exclusions (e.g. Disengage, teleport, being moved without using movement); the reaction must be spent with spend_turn_resource. Rewrite if a named tool doesn't exist.
7. rule:channel-divinity — this record is the MULTICLASSING Channel Divinity rule (text: "If you already have the Channel Divinity feature and gain a level in a class that also grants the feature ..."). design-blocked -> ruleKnownLimits limit 'deferred', findingId 'engine-capability-ownership' (current materialized id), statement from ADR 0018 §1/§6: Eshyra supports single-class characters only (ADR 0018), so this multiclass interaction is deliberately unsupported; a character with more than one class is refused, not adjudicated.
8. A reference-prose key with EMPTY channels: use rule:a-legendary-creatures-lair (verify it is reference-prose with no coverage row). Envelope must say nothing like supported/unsupported/safe/no mechanics.

## Implementation (per design R4-R6, invariants §4)

- New src/rules/ruleAdjudicationContext.ts: typed dataset keyed by rule/action key -> { tools: readonly string[] (each must exist in DEFAULT_TOOLS — validate in a module-level validator used by tests and the audit, NOT by importing orchestrator into rules if that creates a cycle; check how ruleDispositions.ts already validates primitives against DEFAULT_TOOLS and mirror the dependency direction), dmContext: string }. Frozen. Slice rows only: cover, opportunity-attacks, charges.
- New src/rules/ruleKnownLimits.ts: dataset key -> readonly { limit: 'partial'|'unimplemented'|'deferred', statement, findingId, externalClauses?: {clause, findingId}[] }. findingIds validated via findingByCanonicalId. Slice rows: suffocating, channel-divinity.
- Capability ledger: contract UNCHANGED (only the long-rest/short-rest data rows above).
- New facade src/rules/ruleAwareness.ts: `ruleAwareness(recordKey, stack, relationshipManifestSource)` returning the RuleAwareness shape in design R5 exactly (relationshipArtifact {packId,state}, relationships = full resolveRecordRelationships union for the WINNING entry's pack via the supplied source, capabilities = DETERMINISTIC_CAPABILITY_LEDGER.lookup, adjudicationContext?, knownLimits). No default for relationshipManifestSource (required parameter, may be a function returning undefined). Datasets injectable for tests (optional 4th param object) so invariant 1's synthetic test can inject a key carrying all three. Reuse the RelationshipIndex construction that discovery/expansion.ts uses (extract a shared helper if needed rather than duplicating). Watch the rules/ -> discovery/ import direction: RecordRelationshipManifestSource / RelationshipArtifactState types live in discovery/types.ts and bundledDnd5eSrdRecordRelationshipManifestSource in discovery/harness.ts; harness comments say rules/ must not import discovery/. Resolve by moving the TYPES to rules/recordRelationships.ts and re-exporting from discovery/types.ts (keep all existing export names working), or by placing the facade where the dependency direction allows — your call, justify in the PR.
- Audit bundle (ruleDispositions.ts): for the migrated rows, materialize the coverage rows FROM the runtime datasets (import them; object identity — invariant 5, test with toBe) instead of the hand-written legacy entries; remove the legacy entries for those keys so there is one definition. Keep the audit's existing validators passing (175 engine-procedure coverage rows etc.). If an existing test pins a COUNT that legitimately changes (e.g. number of partial rows), replace the count pin with an identity assertion where practical; never weaken an assertion to match output without the R0 evidence above.
- R6 live input: RunTurnDeps (src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts ~line 127) gains `relationshipManifestSource?: RecordRelationshipManifestSource` beside resolveRulesPack; ToolContext (src/orchestrator/toolRegistry.ts:39) gains the same; ONE function resolves the default (`deps.relationshipManifestSource ?? bundledDnd5eSrdRecordRelationshipManifestSource()`) and both the ToolContext construction and shadow/intervention discovery capture (orchestrator.ts ~lines 819-861 and ~1191, which today pass resolveRulesPack but no manifest source) take the value from it.
- lookup_rules (src/orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts): successful result gains `ruleAwareness` envelope beside (never inside) `record`; `record` stays byte-identical to the pack record. Tool description gains one sentence: the ruleAwareness envelope is Eshyra-authored runtime context, not rules text; an empty envelope makes no claim. Check any tool-description snapshot/schema tests and update them.
- Discovery packet (src/discovery/packet.ts dispositionField ~line 677): consume the facade instead of calling DETERMINISTIC_CAPABILITY_LEDGER directly; packet `capabilities[]` still only from bound contracts (invariant 2). Surface adjudication context and known limits in the packet candidate only if the design requires it for probe P1/P2 evidence ("probe P1 packet carries tools + dmContext") — it does for rule:cover and rule:opportunity-attacks; add optional fields to the packet candidate shape and update any packet snapshot/schema tests.
- Registry: sol:CAP-001 row (canonical id 'rule-corpus-procedures') -> status 'narrowed' in docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json (and wherever its generator/source of truth is — find it; regenerate rather than hand-edit if generated), with the design §6 Q2 reasoning text verbatim-ish. opus:F-09 ('rules-prose-readiness') is NOT changed.

## Permanent evidence (tests) — per design §5 and invariants
- facade synthetic channel-independence test (invariant 1, injected datasets).
- lookup_rules through a ToolContext wired with the R6 input, for the full producer set (invariant 9): bundled SRD (action:help -> present, resolved ruleRef); add-on with no manifest -> absent, relationships empty; add-on with its own manifest (reuse test/discovery/support/lateAmbiguityAddon.ts or recordRelationships.test.ts F1 case (c)) -> present under its own declarations; override -> winning producer's manifest governs, losers contribute none.
- lookup_rules rule:long-rest envelope has NO unimplemented limit (stale-promotion guard); rule:suffocating envelope carries the statement + findingId; rule:a-legendary-creatures-lair envelope empty channels and no support/absence claim in text.
- consumer parity (invariant 11): same stack + source => lookup envelope relationships equal discovery relationshipResolutions for that record; orchestrator passes the same source to tool context and discovery capture (test through runTurn deps if an existing orchestrator test harness makes that cheap; otherwise a unit test of the single resolution function).
- audit identity test (invariant 5, toBe).
- probe P1/P2 packet evidence for cover / opportunity-attacks.
Assert identities, not counts. No corpus-wide completeness test.

## Out of scope
Generalization of the remaining legacy rows (design §8 step 3); opus:F-09 registry change; condition->condition edges; any importer/pack change; freeze-manifest hashes (never touch docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json).

## Completion
npm ci in the worktree, then `npm run verify:worktree` must pass before commit. Commit message prefix "eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 ". Append a completion report (files, R0 outcomes, any deviations and why) with bd update --append-notes.
